answer: Proposed gate: each ID/day locks 10 tokens while serving karst and shale maps for sparrow surveys. Validators check separate on-chain escrows and fresh ID-bound replies against committed maps; missed or invalid replies deny listing and forfeit that ID's stake. Success unlocks it after the day. Service costs recur; stake is reusable capital with variable opportunity cost. Honest validators are assumed; maps may be false and rich attackers can pay. Ten concurrent IDs lock 100 tokens: shared servers and parallel calls save service work but cannot double-pledge escrow.
